statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are clinically consistent with hemodynamic instability secondary to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed
The service was ordered for continuous ambulatory assessment to evaluate correlation between symptomatic episodes and underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic changes
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required prior authorization
Required prior authorization was not obtained
